_doc: GEBCO Type Identifier (TID) decode table — EARTH TWIN E2 v2 (research/earth_twin_program.md V4). ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH shared by the pipeline (scripts/gebco_seafloor_tiles.py validates every cell it tiles against these codes) and the client (client/src/lib/seafloorV2.ts renders the confidence overlay + legend from this same file — the iconDataURL principle applied to a decode table). The codes, definitions, and group names are VERBATIM from the official GEBCO_2026 Grid documentation (https://www.gebco.net/data-products-gridded-bathymetry-data/gebco2026-grid, fetched 2026-07-16; the same table ships as GEBCO_Grid_documentation.pdf inside every download-app basket). NEVER edit a definition, add a code, or collapse a group except to mirror a newer official GEBCO document — and then cite it here. The 'confidence' grouping below IS GEBCO's own documented grouping (Land / Direct measurements / Indirect measurements / Unknown), not our invention.

land.label: Land
land.meaning: Land cell — no seafloor reading here.

direct.label: Direct measurements
direct.meaning: Depth measured by an instrument at or near this location (echo-sounder, seismic, lidar, optical, sounding).

indirect.label: Indirect measurements
indirect.meaning: Depth predicted or interpolated (satellite-gravity guided prediction, algorithmic interpolation, chart contours) — not a direct reading at this cell.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.meaning: Depth from a pre-generated/mixed grid, an unknown source, or grid steering points — source type cannot be stated.

10.definition: Singlebeam - depth value collected by a single beam echo-sounder

11.definition: Multibeam - depth value collected by a multibeam echo-sounder

12.definition: Seismic - depth value collected by seismic methods

13.definition: Isolated sounding - depth value that is not part of a regular survey or trackline

14.definition: ENC sounding - depth value extracted from an Electronic Navigation Chart (ENC)

15.definition: Lidar - depth derived from a bathymetric lidar sensor

16.definition: Depth measured by optical light sensor

40.definition: Predicted based on satellite-derived gravity data - depth value is an interpolated value guided by satellite-derived gravity data

41.definition: Interpolated based on a computer algorithm - depth value is an interpolated value based on a computer algorithm (e.g. Generic Mapping Tools)

42.definition: Digital bathymetric contours from charts - depth value taken from a bathymetric contour data set

43.definition: Digital bathymetric contours from ENCs - depth value taken from bathymetric contours from an Electronic Navigation Chart (ENC)

44.definition: Depth value at this location is based on bathymetric depths from multiple sources including measured and derived data and included within a gridded data set where interpolation between sounding points is guided by satellite-derived gravity data

45.definition: Predicted based on helicopter/flight-derived gravity data

46.definition: Depth estimated by calculating the draft of a grounded iceberg using satellite-derived freeboard measurement.

47.definition: Depth derived from grounded Argo float data

48.definition: Depth measured by animal-borne data loggers

70.definition: Pre-generated grid - depth value is taken from a pre-generated grid that is based on mixed source data types, e.g. single beam, multibeam, interpolation etc.

71.definition: Unknown source - depth value from an unknown source

72.definition: Steering points - depth value used to constrain the grid in areas of poor data coverage
